entity.summary: Automated-market-maker decentralized exchange within the Fathom Protocol ecosystem, providing token swaps and decentralized liquidity pools for XDC and FXD-related assets.
entity.notes: HEI models Fathom AMM and Fathom DEX source rows as one exchange entity. Current first-party Fathom site explicitly identifies Fathom DEX as its own stableswap DEX and links the live dapp. First-party documentation describes the AMM pair factory, and current DefiLlama metrics retain non-zero TVL and cumulative DEX volume.

evidence.title: Fathom Protocol official website
evidence.notes: Current first-party site links the live Fathom application at dapp.fathom.fi and explicitly identifies Fathom DEX as Fathom's own stableswap DEX within the ecosystem.

evidence.title: Fathom DEX factory documentation
evidence.notes: First-party documentation describes the Fathom DEX UniswapV2Factory contract as the component responsible for creating and managing liquidity pairs for token exchanges.

evidence.title: Fathom AMM metrics and protocol information
evidence.notes: DefiLlama currently classifies Fathom AMM as a DEX/AMM on XDC and reports non-zero TVL and cumulative DEX volume, supporting continued active classification.
